parsed.post: Keeping DEPTH=8. My last experiment (val_bpb 0.9995) showed that increasing depth from 6 to 8 provides a significant boost in capacity within the 5-minute budget. Next, I will test if lowering the learning rate to 0.04 can further stabilize this larger model and potentially squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 and reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 to improve stability and convergence for the higher capacity model.
